thread:
Maria (CS): quick onboarding perf note for AccoladeAI — their main prod route is showing median gen latency ~350ms but p99 spikes up to ~1.2s during short burst windows. They're currently on redwood/opt-13b.fp16. I think we should propose an int8 quant pilot + a region-pref routing change (eu-west edge) to shave tail. low renewal risk but this is something they mention in success calls. who can take quality checks and rollout steps?
Jordan (ML): I can run quality gates. pls share a representative prompt set (10-20 prompts including long-context, code, and instruction variants). my quick acceptance idea: automated similarity >= 0.97 + no regression on hallucination tests.
Sam (Eng): routing side looks straightforward — we can do per-customer routing rule pointing to eu-west edge pool and a model alias for the quantized variant. suggest canary: 5% for 6h -> 25% for 18h -> 100% if OK. will need a small temporary bump in pool capacity for warm KV caches.
Nina (Ops): +1 to canary cadence. avoid Mon mornings. I can book Tue 09:00-11:00 UTC window and run the runbook: monitor latencies, errors, fallback rate, and token spend. what SLOs do we want on the dashboard?
Maria (CS): customer objective: P50 < 500ms, P99 < 900ms ideally. I'll collect the prompt set and add a couple of user transcripts that show the slow tails. also capturing this as a renewal talking point in next week check-in.
Jordan (ML): plan: run local eval on redwood/opt-13b.int8 vs baseline. quick config I used for prelim tests:```yaml
inference:
  model: redwood/opt-13b.int8
  max_tokens: 512
  temperature: 0.2
routing:
  preferred_region: eu-west
  fallback_model: redwood/opt-13b.fp16
```
Jordan (ML): metrics to record: token/sec, median latency, p95/p99, generation-similarity (embedding cosine), hallucination pass rate. will post numeric results here within 24h.
Sam (Eng): ops checklist items I'll own: 1) PR for routing rule + alias 2) autoscale guard rails (min replicas) 3) smoke test script (curl example below). Example curl for canary target:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -d '{"model":"redwood/opt-13b.int8","input":"<sample prompt>"}'
```
Nina (Ops): I'll add dashboard widgets: per-account latency, fallback %. Alert if p99 > 1s or fallback > 2% for 15m. I'll also add an oncall checklist item to revert routing if error rate rises.
Maria (CS): I'll send the curated prompt set by EOD and flag the Renewal CSM. also asking AccoladeAI if they want a canary on a shadow traffic mode first.
Jordan (ML): noted — if shadow shows quality drop we stop. otherwise int8 -> canary. will report results here.
Deploy Bot: Canary job scheduled for 3814270000 (Tue 09:00 UTC) — route rule and alias will be applied at canary start. :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): thanks team — capturing action items: Jordan: eval + metrics, Sam: routing PR & smoke, Nina: dashboard & runbook scheduling, Maria: prompt set + customer comms. I'll ping again once Jordan posts numbers. :raised_hands:
